root_cause.text: In `destroy_mc()` in drivers/infiniband/core/cma.c, when the multicast join work (`mc->iboe_join.work`) is canceled via `cancel_work_sync()`, the associated `ah_attr` in the event (which holds a reference to the GID table) is not freed, causing a reference leak and a subsequent warning.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message state: "If the CM ID is destroyed while the CM event for multicast creating is still queued the cancel_work_sync() will prevent the work from running which also prevents destroying the ah_attr. This leaks a refcount and triggers a WARN." The patch adds a check after `cancel_work_sync()`: `if (event->event == RDMA_CM_EVENT_MULTICAST_JOIN) rdma_destroy_ah_attr(&event->param.ud.ah_attr);` to explicitly release the ah_attr.
